clue.text: Restrict flow in stretch of pipe

the thin tube of a tobacco pipe between bowl and mouthpiece

clue.text: Author's novel somehow flat

clue.text: Notes the writer meeting doctor at golf club

clue.text: Soldiers permitted to enter gym that's full

clue.text: Poor little Bobby?

clue.text: A device that stops one backing horse

clue.text: Fine fabric that one may cut in strips?
